Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 p_chap_local_date date;
begin 
nullchk;
p_chap_local_date:=Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);

IF :ctrl_blk.drive_date is not null then
 if trunc(:ctrl_blk.drive_date) > trunc(p_chap_local_date) then
 show_error('12056');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 If trunc(:ctrl_blk.end_date) is not null then
 If trunc(:ctrl_blk.drive_date) > trunc(:ctrl_blk.end_date) then
 show_error('16223');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 End If;
END IF;

end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
If :ctrl_blk.end_date is null then
 :ctrl_blk.end_date:=:ctrl_blk.drive_date;
End If;
If trunc(:ctrl_blk.end_date) < trunc(:ctrl_blk.drive_date) then
 show_error('16224');
 check_package_failure;
End if;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
go_block('idp_ierror_log');
set_block_property('idp_ierror_log',default_where,'trunc(insert_date) between :ctrl_blk.drive_date and :ctrl_blk.end_date ');
:system.message_level:=10;
execute_query;
:system.message_level:=0;
FIRST_RECORD;
If :idp_ierror_log.transaction_id is null then
 synchronize;
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
End If;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
go_block('idp_ierror_log');
clear_block(no_validate);
set_block_property('idp_ierror_log',default_where,'trunc(insert_date) between :ctrl_blk.drive_date and :ctrl_blk.end_date ');
:system.message_level:=10;
execute_query;
:system.message_level:=0;
FIRST_RECORD;
If :idp_ierror_log.transaction_id is null then
 synchronize; 
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
End If;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_NAVIGATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF FLG = 'T' THEN 
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_false);
 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;

-- IM:8497
DECLARE
 l_chp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
